'''Carlo Ignazio Giulio''' (11 August 1803 – 29 June 1859) was an Italian mathematician, mechanical engineer and politician.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/carlo-ignazio-giulio_(Dizionario-Biografico)|title=GIULIO, Carlo Ignazio|publisher=[[Treccani|Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana]]|work=Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani|language=it}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://notes9.senato.it/Web/senregno.NSF/d7aba38662bfb3b8c125785e003c4334/2e70487d6bf6497fc1257069003186db?OpenDocument|title=Scheda senatore GIULIO Carlo Ignazio|publisher=[[Senate of the Republic (Italy)|Senate of the Republic]]|language=Italian}}</ref>
